extracted.intended_audience: adult education counselors, teachers, and paraprofessionals
extracted.subtask_description: A training package/module set to teach proposal-writing procedures and related competencies to adult guidance educators (counselors, teachers, paraprofessionals), including module-level learning objectives, assessments, and instructional activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trainee objective: awareness of terminology and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: The role statement describes the trainee objective to demonstrate awareness of adult education terminology and proposal-writing procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the stated competency goal for trainees: they should be able to recognize and use relevant adult education terms and understand the steps/requirements of proposal writing. (No additional scoring guidance provided on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a process to develop and implement programs
rubrics_metrics.description: The materials provide a process for developing and implementing counseling and guidance programs unique to different target populations, program settings, and local conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals and program plans should follow a coherent process and be adapted to the specific target population, setting, and local conditions. (No rubrics or scoring rubrics provided on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modules should clearly state the topic being addressed. (Page lists this as a required/typical module element; no further elaboration provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Learning objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: learning objective
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modules should include explicit learning objectives that state what the trainee will know or be able to do. (No template or scoring rubric supplied on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Rationale
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: rationale
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A rationale should explain why the topic is important and how it fits into broader training/program goals. (Listed as a standard module element; no further detail given.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Preassessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: preassessment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A preassessment is used to gauge trainees' prior knowledge or skills before instruction. (No specific instruments or scoring criteria provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Learning activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: learning activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modules should include active learning tasks and exercises designed to teach the learning objectives. (Examples not detailed on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Postassessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: postassessment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A postassessment should measure the learning outcomes after instruction to determine competency attainment. (No rubrics or scoring guidance provided.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Module component: Appended materials (supplemental materials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each module contains some or all of the following information: appended materials (supplemental activities, tape transcripts, and articles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplementary resources (activities, transcripts, articles) should be provided to reinforce instruction or provide examples. (Page lists examples but offers no standards for selection or evaluation.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on necessary competencies for adult guidance educators
rubrics_metrics.description: This package provides instruction in a set of necessary competencies specifically designed for adult education counselors, teachers, and paraprofessionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training should cover a defined set of competencies relevant to the role; competency attainment is implied as the ultimate marker of success. (No competency list or mastery criteria included on the page.)
